family.description: This domain is found at the C-terminal of FecR [[cite:PUB00151597],[cite:PUB00016138]], which adopts a secretin N0-like fold [[cite:PUB00151597]]. FecARI are responsible for induction of the ferric citrate uptake system. When ferric citrate binds FecA, a signal is transmitted across the outer membrane to FecR, a cytoplasmic membrane protein that transmits signal across the membrane and activates the sigma-70 family protein FecI [[cite:PUB00016138]].
family.name: FecR, C-terminal
